description_en: Modifies a DNS record based on the specified parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数修改解析记录
name: UpdateDomainRecord

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNS record. To obtain the ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2357159.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 解析记录的ID。可通过调取https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2357159.html接口获取
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.help_en:
The host record.
To resolve the root domain, such as example.com, set the host record to the at sign (@)
parameters.help_zh:
主机记录。
当设置主域名解析（如example.com）时，主机记录应填写"@"符号
parameters.name: rr

parameters.help_en:
The type of the DNS record. For more information, see
<props="china">DNS record types (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29805.html).</props>
<props="intl">DNS record types (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/doc-detail/29805.htm).</props>
parameters.help_zh:
解析记录类型，参见：
<props="china">解析记录类型格式 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29805.html)。</props>
<props="intl">解析记录类型格式 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29805.htm)。</props>
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The time to live (TTL). The default value is 600 seconds (10 minutes).
For more information, see
<props="china">TTL definition (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29806.html).</props>
<props="intl">TTL definition (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/doc-detail/29806.htm).</props>
parameters.help_zh:
解析生效时间，默认为600秒（10分钟）。
参见：
<props="china">TTL定义说明 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29806.html)。</props>
<props="intl">TTL定义说明 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29806.htm)。</props>
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the MX record. Valid values: `[1, 50]`.

This parameter is required if the record type is MX
parameters.help_zh:
MX记录的优先级，取值范围：`[1,50]`。

记录类型为MX记录时，此参数必填
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The resolution line. The default value is default.
For more information, see
<props="china">Enumeration of resolution lines (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29807.html).</props>
<props="intl">Enumeration of resolution lines (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/doc-detail/29807.htm).</props>
parameters.help_zh:
解析线路，默认为default。
参见：
<props="china">解析线路枚举 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29807.html)。</props>
<props="intl">解析线路枚举 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29807.htm)。</props>
parameters.name: line

RecordId.description_en: The ID of the DNS record
